Ergocryptine is implicated in targeting the Dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which is a target of multiple compounds, including Ascidiathiazone B and Calcium;4-Oxopentanoate;Dihydrate, all of which also target SK-VLB. Additionally, Ergocryptine is linked to Npc115753, which also leads to SK-VLB. These findings collectively indicate that Ergocryptine may exert its biological effects via a common pathway that involves the Dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which is a key mediator in the target of several compounds, including those that ultimately interact with SK-VLB. The evidence suggests a possible mechanism by which Ergocryptine could influence SK-VLB, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
